info.title: Moon Plan B — frontend draft payloads
info.description: The backend owns the production OpenAPI for the agreed GET /api/v1/dataset route. This AI-assisted frontend draft illustrates proposed parameters, payloads and jobs with synthetic examples. Dates are UTC ISO8601 with Z; angles degrees clockwise from north; durations hours; percentages 0–100. FE displays supplied physics only. Proposed request limit 31 days, pending backend agreement.

get.description: from/to/resolutionSeconds are mandatory. Proposed maximum range 31 days. Only scenarios fully inside the requested window are returned. Native sample cadence may be coarser than requested; sampleStepSeconds reports actual cadence. Empty scenarios is a successful empty result. The frontend proposal rejects requests needing more than 10,000 samples per series at the requested resolution; increase resolutionSeconds or shorten the range.

model.label: Ideal horizon · body centers
model.definition: A body center is above an ideal local horizon when elevation is greater than 0°. These particular angles, sites, intervals and assessments are invented UI test fixtures, not ephemerides.
limits: Terrain, craters and mountains are not modeled.
No disk-edge, eclipse, power-system, antenna or radio-link calculation.
No landing safety conclusion. Sample spacing can hide short events.
Computed ephemerides and this draft contract still require producer and science review.
